content.title: McDonald's to release 'KPop Demon Hunters' menu. When to find it in Tennessee
content.text: March 30, 2026, 8:06 a.m. CTMcDonald's is collaborating with the animated film "KPop Demon Hunters" on new menu items.The promotion includes a Huntr/X Meal and a Saja Boys Breakfast Meal.Each meal comes with a collectible card pack and a QR code for exclusive content.Everything is golden at McDonald's with the collaboration between the fast food giant and the hit animated film "KPop Demon Hunters."McDonald's will introduce new menu items themed around the Academy Award-winning film that will include a head-to-head between Huntr/X and Saja Boys.Each meal will have a collectible card pack that includes a photocard with art of either Huntr/X or the Saja Boys, and a Derpy the Tiger access card with a QR code that unlocks exclusive content via the McDonald's app."With McDonald's, we were able to turn the rivalry between The Saja Boys and Huntr/X into something fans can actually experience, drawing inspiration from Korean culture and food traditions that sit at the heart of the film," said Marian Lee, chief marketing officer for Netflix, in the news release.The animated movie "KPop Demon Hunters" is about a South Korean pop girl group, Huntr/X, that battles demons with music. The Saja Boys, a boy band made up of demons, attempt to disrupt that mission. The soundtrack has been a hit, and the film won two Oscars – one for the song "Golden" and another for best animated feature film. A sequel is also now in the works.Here's what to know about the new meals in Tennessee.What's in the 'KPop Demon Hunters" meals at McDonald's?McDonald's will begin serving a Huntr/X Meal, featuring McNuggets, and a Saja Boys breakfast meal, which comes with a Spicy Saja McMuffin, starting March 31. Here's what's in each meal:The Huntr/X Meal: A 10-piece order of Chicken McNuggets, medium soft drink and Ramyeon McShaker Fries, which have a soy, garlic, sesame and spice seasoning inspired by Rumi, Mira and Zoey's go-to noodle snack. You sprinkle the seasoning into the McShaker bag, toss in the fries and shake to distribute it evenly. The meal also comes with Hunter Sauce, described as "a sweet chili sauce mixing notes of chili, garlic and pepper with just enough heat," and Demon Sauce, which is "a bold mustard sauce with heat and tang – made purple, just like demon patterns."The Saja Boys Breakfast Meal: The Sausage McMuffin with Egg comes topped with a peppery Spicy Saja Sauce. You also get Hash Browns and a small soft drink. "From Ramyeon McShaker Fries to Demon sauces paired with Soda Pop, every detail was designed to feel like it could have come straight out of a scene in the movie," said Netflix's Lee.What is the new 'KPop Demon Hunters" McFlurry at McDonald's?McDonald's also has a new-flavored dessert inspired by Derpy the Tiger, also from the animated film. The Derpy McFlurry blends creamy vanilla soft serve with berry popping pearls in a wild berry sauce."Big things happen when you bring two massive fandoms together, and this partnership was a natural fit," Alyssa Buetikofer, chief marketing and customer experience officer at McDonald's, said in the news release. "We found authentic ways to unite our iconic worlds – inviting Huntr/X and Saja Boys fans into the rivalry in ways that feel true to the film and unmistakably McDonald's."How many McDonald's stores are there in Tennessee?McDonald's has over 300 locations in the Volunteer State, making it one of the state's leading fast-food chains.Find the closest restaurant to you with the McDonald's location page.USA TODAY contributed to this report.Jordan Green covers trending news for The Commercial Appeal and Tennessee. She can be reached at jordan.green@commercialappeal.com.
